title: Landing check: warn on the approval card when uncommitted files in the main checkout would block the landing
lead: *Proposed.* Before the owner approves, the run pane of a run that awaits approval warns when the main checkout has uncommitted or untracked files that the landing's fast-forward merge would collide with, and names them. Approval is still allowed; this only moves the discovery from after the approval to before it.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Landing now checks main before merging (S254): `internal/engine/land.go:63` calls checkMain, which uses dirtyOverlap and dirtyReason in `internal/engine/landdirty.go`. The existing pause regression is TestLandPausesWhenTheFastForwardFails at `internal/engine/land_test.go:794`; it checks dirtyStop before any fast-forward, rather than waiting for git merge to fail. S217 moves discovery to the approval card and leaves landing unchanged.

The warning follows the landing's rule. Reuse changedPaths for main's dirty paths and splitTracking/trackingPath for the project's tracking exclusions (adj 193, landing.tracking-commit). Tracking-only overlap does not warn; config.json and relay-roles.json remain owner changes. At approval, slice changes are still uncommitted: compute its changed set using diff against merge-base plus untracked files, not dirtyOverlap's base...branch diff. Keep repository-relative paths, including for subdirectory projects.

Owner decisions supplied in the 2026-11-08 brief: run.landcheck is a separate read with no run lock; include detached-main and main-on-slice-branch warnings; git read errors show no TUI line. ork approve output stays unchanged. Owner answered 2026-11-08: add optional Reason (JSON reason) for branch-state warnings; keep Blockers as filenames and Error as hidden read failures.

sections.body:
`internal/engine/landcheck_test.go` (new; compile error before CheckLanding exists):

- TestCheckLandingIgnoresDirtyFilesTheMergeDoesNotTouch: unrelated tracking edits and scratch.txt do not warn.
- TestCheckLandingNamesATrackedFileModifiedInMain: overlapping committed slice edit warns.
- TestCheckLandingCountsUncommittedWorktreeChanges: overlapping uncommitted slice edit warns.
- TestCheckLandingNamesAnUntrackedFileInTheWay: overlapping untracked file warns.
- TestCheckLandingHandlesRenamesAndSpaces: NUL parsing counts both rename names and paths with spaces.
- TestCheckLandingReportsAMainCheckoutThatIsNotOnABranch: owner selected branch warnings; match the landing reason at `internal/engine/land.go:50-51`.
- TestCheckLandingReportsMainOnTheSliceBranch: match the landing reason at `internal/engine/land.go:53-54`.
- TestCheckLandingGitFailureIsAnErrorNotAWarning: read failure returns Error, no blockers.
- TestCheckLandingNeverWrites: only read commands, including rev-parse for project prefix.
- TestCheckLandingIgnoresTrackingOnlyOverlap: reuse S254 tracking exclusions (adj 193).
- TestCheckLandingIncludesTrackingConfigOverlap: config.json and relay-roles.json remain blockers.
- TestLandPausesWhenTheFastForwardFails (existing regression; do not duplicate as TestLandPauseStillHappensWhenTheCheckWasSkipped): preserve the existing S254 dirtyStop/dirtyReason pause before merge; TestLandPausesWhenTheFastForwardFails at `internal/engine/land_test.go:794`.

`internal/daemon/landcheck_test.go`:
- TestRunLandCheckOnlyForAwaitingApprovalWithLandStop: other states and stop_after=commit return empty without git.
- TestRunLandCheckUnknownRunIsNotFound.
- TestRunLandCheckDoesNotWaitForTheRun: read stored record without run lock while another run is busy.

`internal/tui/card_test.go` and `internal/tui/live_test.go`:
- TestCardShowsLandWarningWithBlockers: warning names files above approve hint.
- TestCardLandWarningTruncatesLongLists: three names then +N more.
- TestCardWithoutBlockersLooksAsBefore: existing approval goldens byte-identical.
- TestCardLandWarningOutlastsTheLandNoteAt80x24: note drops first.
- TestCardChecksLandingWhenThePaneOpensAndOnEachRefresh: one call per open and matching refresh, none per redraw.
- TestCardShowsNothingWhenTheCheckErrors: owner selected no error line.
- New pane-approval-card-landwarn goldens at 80x24 and 100x30, generated first with -update and inspected.
Branch warnings use optional Reason (JSON reason), per owner answer 2026-11-08.
Additional self-check regressions: TestCheckLandingSubdirectoryProject, TestCheckLandingSortsAndDeduplicates, TestRunLandCheckReturnsFileOverlap, TestCardShowsLandingBranchReason and TestCardLandCheckIgnoresOldReplies. Sorting, duplicate names, older replies and reopened panes each have mutation evidence.
Fix-round UI regression: TestCardLandWarningStaysOrDropsWhole renders nine human checks in the 60-column content pane of an 80-column terminal, sweeping pane heights 1 through 30. A visible warning must include all filenames and the final advice; a crowded pane may drop it only as a whole group.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first. Do not touch the landing itself (land, mergeBaseIn), the approve key or its human-check rule, ork approve output, or tracking files directly.

1. Preflight: owner decisions supplied in the 2026-11-08 brief override the older recommended answers. Compute in run.landcheck; include branch-state warnings; hide git read errors. Owner selected optional Reason string (JSON reason) for branch warnings.
2. Add internal/engine/landcheck.go. LandCheck fields are Base, Blockers, Error and Reason (all JSON omitempty); Reason carries branch-state warnings. CheckLanding reads main's branch with symbolic-ref --short HEAD and compares it to the slice branch (land.go:50-54). Use gitRead (round.go:87) and its 30-second timeout. Reuse changedPaths (filescope.go:36) for main status, including both rename names. Compute the slice changed set using merge-base BASE HEAD, diff --name-only -z --no-renames --no-relative MERGE_BASE in the worktree, plus ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z for its untracked files. Intersect exact paths, sort and deduplicate. Reuse splitTracking/trackingPath (landdirty.go:86-95), with rev-parse --show-prefix for subdirectory projects; omit this project's tracking files, except config.json and relay-roles.json, because landing commits tracking-only overlap (adj 193). Do not reuse dirtyOverlap's committed-only base...branch changed set: approval precedes the commit. Directory-versus-file clashes are not detected; document this limitation.
3. Add daemon run.landcheck, params {run}, result LandCheck. Open stored record like runRender (runs.go:2228), without a run lock. Return empty unless state is awaiting-approval and stop_after is land or absent. Find registered project, then call engine.CheckLanding.
4. Add Live.LandCheck and daemon wrapper. Fetch in a command on awaiting-approval pane open and each refresh of that run; never perform I/O in Update or redraw. Keep last result in pane state; clear on pane close or leaving awaiting-approval. Failed calls show nothing and do not block keys. File warning wording: Landing will stop: main has uncommitted changes to A, B, C (+2 more). Commit, stash or remove them first. Warning outlasts cardLandNote in footer drop order. Branch warnings display Reason using the landing's existing reason text.
5. Update docs/dashboard.md Approval card, docs/design.md method table and landing, docs/guide.md section 10 in the same diff. Explain warning-only behavior (a still works), tracking exclusions, rename support and directory-clash limitation. No persisted result, so no docs/state.md change.
6. Write new landwarn goldens at 80x24 and 100x30 with go test ./internal/tui -update and inspect. Existing approval goldens must remain byte-identical.
7. Add CHANGELOG entry last under Unreleased: Landing check (*proposed*): ...

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui`.
- `git diff --stat -- testdata/golden` shows only the two new `landwarn` files.
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and 80x24 in a live terminal: start a small slice, dirty a file it changes in the main checkout while it awaits approval, open the pane and read the warning; clean the file and see it go away on the next refresh; leave a `.slicer/` file modified and see no warning.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] The next real landing with an unrelated dirty `.slicer/` file shows no warning and lands.
